basics.name: Dan Chen
basics.label: Research Fellow
basics.summary: Research Fellow at the School of Computing, National University of Singapore (NUS). I design energy-efficient, high-performance AI systems through software–hardware co-design, focusing on near-memory computing and specialized architectures for emerging AI workloads.

work.name: National University of Singapore (NUS), School of Computing
work.summary: Working with Prof. Tulika Mitra on AI system acceleration and architectural optimization.
highlights: Heterogeneous near-memory systems and specialized architectures for LLM/RAG acceleration.
Energy-efficient designs for sparse operators and graph workloads via software–hardware co-design.

education.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
courses: Research focus: AI system acceleration, near-memory computing, and architectures for graph/sparse/LLM workloads.
